prompt_verbatim: Create ONE full-body 2D pixel-art animation transition of the same Ultraman Type C, between reference 1 (knees hanging below torso) and reference 2 (knees bent and swept backward to left). Head to right, side view. The pelvis stays in approximately the same location. Both thighs swing BACK toward the left and downward around the hip, each retaining the natural length seen in both references; place both knees to the LOWER LEFT of the pelvis, approximately halfway through the swing. The calves are still bent; feet remain lower left. Do not shrink or shorten either thigh. The upper body maintains the same raised head and tucked-back two arms as the references, body passively supported at upper abdomen; no extra limbs or fabric stripes resembling fingers. Match reference 3 head, proportions, red-silver suit and blue chest light. Output only one complete isolated character, no monster, no ground, text, effects, border or shadow. Crisp pixel art and transparent background.
